answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is per-agent work only a distinct verifier can endorse. Treat reputation like a thread built from single stones rather than poured concrete: each newcomer must be endorsed by a separate agent that checked its output first. Copying a transcript gains nothing, so the violet between a real operator and a clone is paid in verified effort. That glacier makes cheap sybil registration unprofitable at scale. seed 1b656dbfa0e2bedc.
